name: Halyard Contact
description: A dark topic router: a card per topic with a line saying what it is for, and the form opening on the one somebody picks — asking only that topic’s questions.
features: Router preset: topic cards first, then that topic’s form
Each topic asks its own questions (a bug report asks severity, sales asks team size)
A channels band under the form: your docs, community, status and changelog, plus your own links
Dark, quiet tokens with an outlined form card
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

pages.title: Contact
pages.markdown:
Not sure which topic fits? Write to us directly and we will route it to the right person.

## Before you write

- For a bug, say what you expected to happen and what happened instead.
- Include the workspace it happened in — we will never ask for your password.
- One topic per message keeps each answer fast.
